en: With je, avoir is ai. J’ai mangé means I ate.
With tu, avoir is as: tu as fini.
With elle, avoir is a: elle a regardé.
With nous, avoir is avons: nous avons joué.
With vous, avoir is avez: vous avez visité.
With ils, avoir is ont: ils ont acheté.
What is the past participle of manger?
-er verbs drop -er and add -é: manger becomes mangé.
What is the past participle of finir?
-ir verbs like finir drop the r: fini.
What is the past participle of vendre?
-re verbs like vendre end in -u: vendu.
What is the past participle of faire?
Faire is irregular. Its past participle is fait: j’ai fait.
What is the past participle of prendre?
Prendre is irregular. Its past participle is pris: j’ai pris le bus.
What is the past participle of voir?
Voir is irregular. Its past participle is vu: j’ai vu.
What is the past participle of boire?
Boire is irregular. Its past participle is bu: j’ai bu.
What is the past participle of lire?
Lire is irregular. Its past participle is lu: j’ai lu.
What is the past participle of écrire?
Écrire is irregular. Its past participle is écrit: j’ai écrit.
After j’ai, you need the past participle lu.
Ce matin, nous avons ___ le petit déjeuner.
After avons, you need the past participle pris.
Elle a ___ une lettre à sa tante.
After a, use the past participle écrit.
J’ai plus a past participle talks about the past: I played.
What does Ils ont dansé mean?
Ils ont dansé is the passé composé, so it is in the past.
How do you say We listened to the radio in French?
The past needs avons plus the past participle écouté.
How do you say She finished her lunch in French?
The past participle of finir is fini. Elle finit is the present.
Which sentence is in the past?
Tu as chanté uses avoir and a past participle, so it is the past.
Ne … pas goes around avoir, then comes the past participle trouvé.
In the past, ne … pas goes around the form of avoir: il n’a pas dormi.
Hier soir, vous avez ___ du chocolat chaud.
After avez, use the past participle bu.
Gagner is an -er verb, so its past participle is gagné.
Which word is the past participle in Nous avons vu un film?
Vu is the past participle of voir. Avons is the form of avoir.
Le week-end dernier, nous ___ fait du vélo.
Faire takes avoir in the past: nous avons fait.
After as, use the past participle appelé.

example.why_en: With je, avoir is ai. J’ai mangé means I ate.

en.title: The past with avoir
en.teach: The passé composé uses avoir in the present plus a past participle. Most -er verbs end in -é: J’ai mangé une pomme. (I ate an apple.)
